what_is_it.heading: Umhlaza womlomo wesibeleko ngamazwi alula
what_is_it.lede: Umhlaza womlomo wesibeleko ngumhlaza womlomo wesibeleko - emazantsi esibeleko. Phantse zonke iimeko (ngaphezu kwama-99%) zibangelwa usulelo lwexesha elide kunye neentlobo ezinobungozi obuphezulu be-HPV (Human Papillomavirus).
paragraphs: I-HPV ixhaphake kakhulu - uninzi lwabantu ababelana ngesondo bayayibamba ngaxa lithile. Umzimba ususa uninzi losulelo lwe-HPV kunyaka okanye emibini. Kodwa ukuba uhlobo olusemngciphekweni omkhulu luyaqhubeka iminyaka eyi-10-15, lunokubangela ukuba iiseli zomlomo wesibeleko zitshintshe kancinci zibe ngumhlaza wangaphambi komhlaza, emva koko umhlaza.

Lo mgca wexesha elide yinto eyenza umhlaza womlomo wesibeleko ube ngowona mhlaza unokuthinteleka kwihlabathi. Ukuhlolwa (i-Pap smear okanye uvavanyo lwe-HPV) lubamba utshintsho lweeseli kwiminyaka ngaphambi kokuba umhlaza uqhambuke - xa unyango lulula. Isitofu sokugonya se-HPV sithintela usulelo olubangela kwasekuqaleni.

items.headline: Okwesibini okuqhelekileyo
items.body: Umhlaza womlomo wesibeleko ngowona mhlaza wesibini uxhaphakileyo kwabasetyhini baseMzantsi Afrika. Awona mazinga aphezulu kubasetyhini abaneminyaka engama-35 ukuya kwengama-55.

items.headline: 99% HPV
items.body: Ngaphezu kwe-99% yomhlaza womlomo wesibeleko ubangelwa lusulelo lwe-HPV lwexesha elide. Ukuyeka i-HPV kunqanda umhlaza.

items.headline: Isitofu sokugonya sasimahla
items.body: Isitofu sokugonya iHPV sisimahla kumantombazana eBanga lesi-5 (kwaye ngoku singamakhwenkwe akumaphondo amaninzi) ngeprogram yesikolo. Eyona nto inikezelweyo ngaphambi kokuqala ngokwesondo.

items.headline: Ii-Pap smears zisindisa ubomi
items.body: I-Pap smear yasimahla rhoqo emva kweminyaka eli-10 ukusuka kwiminyaka engama-30 kwiikliniki zikarhulumente. Rhoqo kwiminyaka emi-3 ukuba une-HIV. Ubamba utshintsho phambi komhlaza.

pull_quote.text: Ukuba wonke owasetyhini eMzantsi Afrika uyagonywa eyintombazana aze avavanywe ebudaleni, singawuphelisa umhlaza womlomo wesibeleko kwisizukulwana. Izixhobo zikhona. Bakhululekile.
pull_quote.source: Inyathelo le-WHO lokuphelisa umhlaza womlomo wesibeleko

signs.heading: Yintoni onokuyibona
signs.lede: Ukutshintsha kwangoko komlomo wesibeleko-kuquka umhlaza wangaphambi komhlaza kunye nomhlaza wangethuba-kaninzi akubangeli zimpawu. Kungenxa yoko le nto ukuhlolwa kubalulekile. Iimpawu zivela xa umhlaza uhambele phambili.

items.title: Early - cwaka
items.description: Umhlaza wangaphambi komhlaza kunye nomhlaza wokuqala awubangeli zimpawu. Kuphela yiPap smear okanye uvavanyo lweHPV oluthi lutshintshe oku kwangoko.

items.title: Kamva - ukopha
items.description: Ukopha phakathi kwexesha, emva kokwabelana ngesondo, okanye emva kokuyeka ukuya exesheni. Amaxesha anzima okanye amade kunesiqhelo. Ukukhutshwa okungaqhelekanga kwilungu lobufazi.

items.title: Ukwinqanaba eliphezulu - bonana nogqirha
items.description: Iintlungu ze-pelvic, iintlungu ezisezantsi, intlungu ngexesha lokwabelana ngesondo, ukudumba komlenze, igazi kumchamo okanye isitulo. Ezi zifuna uvavanyo olungxamisekileyo.

items.myth: Ngabasetyhini kuphela abanamaqabane amaninzi abafumana i-HPV.
items.fact: I-HPV ixhaphake kakhulu - uninzi lwabantu ababelana ngesondo bayayibamba. Nokuba iqabane elinye liyakwazi ukuyisasaza. Ugonyo lukhusela nokuba ithini na imbali yeqabane.

items.myth: Ugonyo lwe-HPV lukhuthaza abantu abatsha ukuba baqale ngesondo kwangoko.
items.fact: Iminyaka yophando ibonisa ukuba akukho khonkco phakathi kogonyo lwe-HPV kunye nomsebenzi wangaphambili wesondo. Isitofu sokugonya sisebenza ngcono xa sinikwa phambi kokuba ube sesichengeni ngokwesondo.

items.myth: Ukuba bendinogonyo lwe-HPV, andizidingi ii-Pap smears.
items.fact: Isitofu sokugonya sithintela uninzi kodwa ayizizo zonke iintlobo zeHPV ezisemngciphekweni omkhulu. Uvavanyo lusebalulekile - isitofu sokugonya kunye novavanyo kunye lolona khuselo lunamandla.

items.myth: Umhlaza womlomo wesibeleko uqhuba kwiintsapho - akukho nto ndinokuyenza.
items.fact: Imbali yosapho yinto encinci yomngcipheko kakhulu. Usulelo lwe-HPV ngunobangela phantse kuwo wonke umhlaza womlomo wesibeleko - kwaye i-HPV iyathintelwa kwaye iyabhaqwa.

prevention.heading: Indlela yokuzikhusela
prevention.lede: Umhlaza womlomo wesibeleko ngowona mhlaza unokuthinteleka kuba kukho zombini isitofu sokugonya kunye novavanyo olusebenzayo. Wonke umfazi omdala kufuneka azi isicwangciso sakhe.

items.title: Ugonyo lweHPV
items.description: Isimahla eMzantsi Afrika kumantombazana eBanga lesi-5 (kunye namakhwenkwe kumaphondo amaninzi). Okona kulungileyo phambi kokuba kuqale umsebenzi wesondo kodwa usebenze nakweyiphi na iminyaka - cela ikliniki yakho ukuya kuthi ga kwiminyaka engama-45.

items.title: Ii-Pap smears rhoqo
items.description: Isimahla kwiikliniki ukusuka kwiminyaka engama-30 ubudala, rhoqo kwiminyaka eli-10 ukuba kuqhelekile. Rhoqo kwiminyaka emi-3 ukuba une-HIV. Qala kwangethuba kwaye ukhuse rhoqo ukuba unembali yeziphumo ezingaqhelekanga.

items.title: Iikhondom
items.description: Nciphisa usulelo lwe-HPV kodwa ungayisusi — I-HPV inokusasazeka elukhumbeni olungagqunywanga yikhondom. Kuseluncedo, ngakumbi namaqabane amatsha.

items.title: Musa ukutshaya
items.description: Ukutshaya kuwenza buthathaka amandla omlomo wesibeleko ekucoceni usulelo lwe-HPV kwaye kuphinda kabini ingozi yomhlaza womlomo wesibeleko kwabasetyhini abane-HPV.

items.title: Ukuba unentombi kwiBanga lesi-5
items.description: Qinisekisa ukuba ufumana isitofu sokugonya i-HPV ngenkqubo yesikolo. Iidosi ezimbini, simahla, zinikwe ngokwahlukeneyo kwiinyanga ezintandathu. Esi sesona sixhobo sinamandla sokuthintela umhlaza esinaso.

items.title: Ukuba uneminyaka engama-30 okanye ngaphezulu
items.description: Bhukisha i-Pap smear kuyo nayiphi na ikliniki karhulumente ukuba awukhange uyenze kule minyaka ili-10 idlulileyo. Isimahla, ithatha imizuzu emihlanu, iziphumo kwiiveki ezi-2-4.

items.title: Ukuba une-HIV
items.description: Ukuhlolwa rhoqo kwiminyaka emi-3 kungakhathaliseki ubudala, ukususela ekuxilongweni ukuya phambili. I-HPV iziphatha ndlongondlongo kakhulu kwi-HIV — ungatsibi.

items.title: Ukuba wopha ngokungaqhelekanga
items.description: Ukopha phakathi kwexesha, emva kokwabelana ngesondo, okanye emva kokuyeka ukuya exesheni - bonana nekliniki. Oonobangela abaninzi ayingomhlaza, kodwa umhlaza womlomo wesibeleko sesinye sezizathu ezifuna ukubanjwa kwangoko.

items.title: Ukuba iPap smear yakho ayiqhelekanga
items.description: Musa ukuphaphazela. Uninzi lweziphumo ezingaqhelekanga zezomhlaza wangaphambili onokunyangwa kutyelelo olunye. Landela — inkqubo iyasebenza ukuba uyawagcina amadinga akho.

get_help.heading: Masiye phi
get_help.lede: Ukuhlolwa komlomo wesibeleko, unyango lomhlaza wangaphambi komhlaza, kunye nesitofu sokugonya se-HPV zonke zisimahla kwiikliniki zoluntu zaseMzantsi Afrika. Isiseko sothintelo lomhlaza sikhona - sisebenzise.

helplines.name: Fumana eyona kliniki ikufutshane nawe
helplines.description: Izitofu zokugonya ze-HPV zasimahla, ii-Pap smears, kunye nokulandelelwa kweziphumo ezingaqhelekanga
